title.narrative: Strengthening Capacity in the Use of Country Systems Safeguards

description.narrative: TF099383 Given the extent and complexity of the environmental and social safeguards work recently led by APIX on behalf of the Government of Senegal on the Dakar Toll Road as well as other infrastructure investmentscomma AFTQK and ASPEN are proposing this US$487comma880 IDF grant to strengthen country system capacity in the areas of environmental and social safeguards in Senegal. The purpose of this IDF grant is to build country capacity to assesscomma manage and monitor the environmental and social safeguards risks in development projects to reduce the negative externalities of large-scale infrastructure investments in the energy and transport sectors and targeted interventions in other sectors. Grant activities would include all Senegalese agencies involved in infrastructure investmentscomma in particular the Ministry of Investmentcomma with APIX leading the work as the grant recipient. The grant will permit APIX to determine where current safeguards capacities lie as well as identify key gaps in government capabilities regarding safeguards assessmentcomma planningcomma monitoring and management within and across ministries. Grant funds will be earmarked for baseline diagnostic work as well as activities to strengthen incentives for adopting best practice with respect to safeguards processes and tools as well as provide support for skills enhancement and training among government technical staff tasked with application and oversight of investment project safeguards. The Development Objective of this grant is to strengthen the assessmentcomma enforcement and monitoring and evaluation capacity of national safeguard practitioners in the use of Senegal's environmental and social safeguards country systems.
